SUPPLY AGREEMENT 

Section break. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. 

Section break. Either party may terminate this Agreement for any reason upon ninety (90) days prior written notice. Upon such termination, Buyer shall pay for all Products delivered before the effective date of termination. 

Section break. In no event shall Acme Widgets, Inc. be liable for more than $250,000, and any late delivery shall incur liquidated damages of 2% of the order value per week. 

Section break. Neither party may assign. 

Section break.
